evaluated.question: preview_add_prompts.md is a generated reference. What generates it (which script, from which source: the backend tool's input schema/field descriptions?), and was this row produced by running that generator or edited by hand? If by hand, will the next regeneration keep it or overwrite it?
evaluated.answer:
The generator produced this row; it was not edited by hand. Session d07e7e87, entries ~1101-1255.

WHAT GENERATES IT
- seerly-mcp `scripts/generate-references.ts` (`npm run references`) connects to the live server (default https://seerly.app/api/mcp, needs `SEERLY_TOKEN`), calls `tools/list`, and passes the tools to `writeReferences`.
- `writeReferences` deletes every file in plugin/skills/seerly/references, then writes one `<tool>.md` per tool via `renderReference` (scripts/render-reference.ts).
- The renderer uses only name, title, description, `inputSchema` and `annotations.readOnlyHint`. It does not render output shapes. (From reading the scripts.)
- The ultimate source is the backend tool's zod input schema and its `.describe()` strings: airo-backend `src/core/mcp/writes/add-prompts.tool.ts`, which the MCP SDK serves as JSON Schema in tools/list.

HOW THIS ROW WAS PRODUCED
- `npm run references` itself could not run, because this Mac has no `SEERLY_TOKEN` (no stored sign-in at ~/.seerly/mcp).
- Instead, tools/list was produced from merged backend main 01a60485 (the PR #340 merge commit). A throwaway jest spec built the server through the real `McpServerFactory` in per-call scope and dumped tools/list to JSON ("26 tools").
- That JSON went into the repo's own exported `writeReferences` via a scratchpad script. The script comment says: "Feeds a dumped tools/list into seerly-mcp's own writeReferences (same renderer as `npm run references`)."
- Final message (1386): "I regenerated it from the merged backend code, since this Mac has no Seerly token for `npm run references`. The other 25 pages came out unchanged."

WILL THE NEXT REGENERATION KEEP IT
- Yes, as long as prod serves merged main's schema. The row text is the backend's describe() string verbatim: I read add-prompts.tool.ts:49-56 and it is identical. (Inference, from the code.)
- Prod now runs that build: "Build and Deploy Backend completed success 01a60485 2026-11-23T05:16:52Z".
- Not verified: a real `npm run references` against the live server producing an empty diff. That was never run.

evaluated.question: The new row documents a `prompts[].sourceCluster` input the backend must accept. Has the backend change that adds this field (and its fallback: topic's linked cluster, else none) already merged and deployed to prod? If not, what happens when a plugin user's agent sends `sourceCluster` to a server that does not know it yet (rejected by schema validation, or silently ignored)?
evaluated.answer:
MERGED AND DEPLOYED: yes, before this commit was made.
- `gh pr view 340` → {"mergedAt":"2026-11-23T05:12:06Z","sha":"01a60485...","state":"MERGED"}.
- `gh run list` → "Build and Deploy Backend completed success 01a60485 2026-11-23T05:16:52Z".
- User, mid-turn (entry 1256): "I have deployed changes to prod. Lets ensure that we put these stock broker prompts using mcp plugin".
- Live proof: preview_add_prompts then add_prompts through the Seerly MCP, sending `sourceCluster` on all 4 prompts. Read-only psql afterwards showed `source_cluster` stored on each: "trading in india" x2, "Global stock market", "Stock advisory services".
- The page was committed (0b32d22) after that prod check.
- Fallback wording: matches merged backend code. `resolveSourceCluster(picked, topicCluster)` in src/core/project/utils/source-cluster.util.ts returns the trimmed picked label, else the topic's linked `sourceClusterLabel`, else null. (Inference, from the code.)
- Not checked: that both blue/green slots serve the new build. Only the GitHub deploy run status was read.

IF A SERVER WITHOUT THE FIELD RECEIVED IT: silently ignored, not rejected.
- Session (1025), describing pre-#340 prod: "The MCP has no field for it, and a new topic has no linked cluster to fall back to, so all 4 prompts would save with a NULL `source_cluster`."
- Session (852): "an `add_prompts` that lands on the old blue/green deployment would drop `sourceCluster` and still run the LLM anchor step."
- Code reading: the tool input is plain zod objects, and there is no `.strict()`, `strictObject` or `passthrough` anywhere under src/core/mcp (I grepped), so zod's default strips unknown keys. The prompt still saves; it gets the topic's linked cluster or NULL. (Inference.)
- The only remaining exposure is a request reaching an old blue/green slot during a deploy window.

evaluated.question: Where does an agent get a `sourceCluster` value to pass? Does a read tool (get_prompt_ideas or similar) now return it, and if so, is that tool's reference doc expected to change too, or is this one row the whole of the docs change for the feature? Likewise, does add_prompts (the commit-by-previewId action) need any doc change?
evaluated.answer:
WHERE AN AGENT GETS A VALUE
- No read tool was changed to return `sourceCluster`. PR #340's MCP change was only `src/core/mcp/writes/add-prompts.tool.ts` (plus the backend service and specs), per the session.
- Existing read tools that already expose keyword-universe cluster labels (inference, from code and the reference pages):
  - `get_keywords` (actions clusters, cluster_keywords, keywords): "The project's keyword universe: clusters with volume, head terms and their long-tail keywords".
  - `get_prompt_ideas`: its `uncovered_keyword_clusters` section calls keywords/clusters (src/core/mcp/jobs/prompt-ideas.job.ts:40-46).
  - Its `current_prompts` fields do NOT include sourceCluster (PROMPT_FIELDS, lines 7-18).
- In this session the values did not come from an MCP read tool. They were looked up on prod with psql: the anchor keyword's `l1_cluster` in the keyword universe, e.g. "best stock broker in india" → "trading in india" (entry 755). Same convention as the earlier 11-12 and 11-15 SQL rounds.
- The backend does not check the value against the project's universe. Any trimmed string up to 255 chars is stored (source-cluster.util.ts). A wrong label is saved as-is. (Inference, from the code.)
- Not discussed in the session: whether the skill should tell agents where to get cluster labels. SKILL.md was not touched.

IS THIS ONE ROW THE WHOLE DOCS CHANGE
- Yes, for the generated references. All 26 pages were regenerated from merged main, and only preview_add_prompts.md changed. So no other tool's input schema or description changed in #340.
- Caveat: reference pages show inputs only. Output shapes are never rendered, so they would not show up here either way.

add_prompts.md
- No change needed. add_prompts takes only `previewId` (its page lists that single argument), so the prompt fields appear on the preview page only.
- Its page was rewritten byte-identical by the generator.
